brief: Build a conservative income estimate from an irregular payment history.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Plan with uneven receipts"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Planea con entradas variables"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Planeje com entradas variáveis"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Build a conservative income estimate from an irregular payment history.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Use history cautiously when future payments are uncertain.
instruction.misconception: Treat the best month or historical average as a guaranteed minimum.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Recent receipts were 80, 120 and 90 dollars. Using the lowest is cautious, but still not guaranteed.
An exceptional peak is weak evidence for dependable income.
A historical estimate is not a payment agreement.
The requested rule chooses the lowest observed amount.
A changed work source can invalidate an old baseline.
One high month does not prove a permanent income change.
Seasonal peaks do not describe every future period.

en-US.line: Recent receipts were 80, 120 and 90 dollars. Using the lowest is cautious, but still not guaranteed.

en-US.scene: The largest past receipt included an unusual bonus; ordinary months were lower.

options.label: Assume the best month always repeats

help: Look at the pattern, not only the peak.

feedback.not_yet: Mira el patrón, no solo el máximo.

en-US.prompt: Does that make the amount guaranteed?

options.label: Yes, a smaller number cannot fail

feedback.met: A historical estimate is not a payment agreement.
